answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 168361 Country: Bangladesh Title: What is the difference between ‘Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam and Alaihiwasallam’? Question: What is the difference between ‘Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam and Alaihiwasallam’? Answer ID: 168361 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 571/567/M=06/1440) The sentence ‘Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam’ contains both durood and salam while ‘Alaihis Salam’ contains only salam. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
